title: maas-dev | OTel Trace Explorer
description: 从 ClickHouse 按 Trace ID 查看 maas-dev 的调用链。

panels.title: Trace 搜索
panels.description: 显示选定时间内最近 100 条 Trace。点击 Trace ID 查看详情。耗时窗口按当前时间范围内可见 Span 计算。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    min(start_time) AS time,
    trace_id,
    argMin(service_name, tuple(parent_span_id != '', start_time, span_id)) AS entry_service,
    argMin(name, tuple(parent_span_id != '', start_time, span_id)) AS entry_operation,
    (max(end_time_unix_nano) - min(start_time_unix_nano)) / 1000000. AS trace_window_ms,
    uniqExact(span_id) AS spans,
    uniqExactIf(span_id, status_code = 2) AS error_spans,
    arrayStringConcat(arraySort(groupUniqArray(service_name)), ', ') AS services
FROM llm_observability.otel_traces_maas_dev_grafana
WHERE cluster_id = 'maas-dev' AND is_valid = 1
  AND $__timeFilter_ms(start_time)
GROUP BY trace_id
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 100

panels.title: Waterfall
panels.description: 按 Trace ID 查找，最多 1000 个 Span。数据读取范围为 ClickHouse 当前保留的数据。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    trace_id AS traceID,
    span_id AS spanID,
    parent_span_id AS parentSpanID,
    service_name AS serviceName,
    name AS operationName,
    toUnixTimestamp64Nano(start_time) / 1000000. AS startTime,
    ifNull(duration_ms, 0.) AS duration,
    kind,
    status_code AS statusCode
FROM (
    SELECT trace_id, span_id, parent_span_id, service_name, name, start_time, duration_ms, kind, status_code
    FROM (
        SELECT trace_id, span_id, parent_span_id, service_name, name, start_time, duration_ms, kind, status_code
        FROM llm_observability.otel_traces_maas_dev_grafana
        WHERE cluster_id = 'maas-dev'
          AND is_valid = 1
          AND trace_id = lowerUTF8(${trace_id:sqlstring})
        ORDER BY span_id, ingested_at DESC
        LIMIT 1 BY span_id
    )
    ORDER BY start_time, span_id
    LIMIT 1000
)
ORDER BY startTime, spanID

panels.title: Call Map
panels.description: 父 Span 在左，子 Span 在右。相同调用深度内按开始时间从上往下排列。显示最早的 200 个 Span。

targets.rawSql:
WITH spans AS (
    SELECT span_id, parent_span_id, service_name, name, start_time, duration_ms, status_code
    FROM (
        SELECT span_id, parent_span_id, service_name, name, start_time, duration_ms, status_code
        FROM llm_observability.otel_traces_maas_dev_grafana
        WHERE cluster_id = 'maas-dev'
          AND is_valid = 1
          AND trace_id = lowerUTF8(${trace_id:sqlstring})
        ORDER BY span_id, ingested_at DESC
        LIMIT 1 BY span_id
    )
    ORDER BY start_time, span_id
    LIMIT 200
), parent_index AS (
    SELECT mapFromArrays(groupArray(span_id), groupArray(parent_span_id)) AS parents
    FROM spans
), positioned_spans AS (
    SELECT spans.*,
           arrayFold(
               (state, step) -> if(
                   mapContains(parents, parents[state.1]),
                   (parents[state.1], state.2 + toUInt64(1)),
                   state
               ),
               range(length(mapKeys(parents))),
               (span_id, toUInt64(0))
           ).2 AS depth
    FROM spans CROSS JOIN parent_index
)
SELECT
    span_id AS id,
    name AS title,
    service_name AS subtitle,
    concat(toString(round(ifNull(duration_ms, 0.), 2)), ' ms') AS mainstat,
    if(status_code = 2, '#E02F44', '#3274D9') AS color,
    parent_span_id AS detail__parent_span_id,
    toFloat64(depth) * 195 AS fixedX,
    (toFloat64(row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY depth ORDER BY start_time, span_id))
        - (toFloat64(count() OVER (PARTITION BY depth)) + 1) / 2) * 91 AS fixedY
FROM positioned_spans
-- Preserve frame fields when ClickHouse returns zero rows.
UNION ALL
SELECT '__grafana_schema_only__', '', '', '', '', '', toFloat64(0), toFloat64(0)

WITH spans AS (
    SELECT span_id, parent_span_id, service_name, name, start_time, duration_ms, status_code
    FROM (
        SELECT span_id, parent_span_id, service_name, name, start_time, duration_ms, status_code
        FROM llm_observability.otel_traces_maas_dev_grafana
        WHERE cluster_id = 'maas-dev'
          AND is_valid = 1
          AND trace_id = lowerUTF8(${trace_id:sqlstring})
        ORDER BY span_id, ingested_at DESC
        LIMIT 1 BY span_id
    )
    ORDER BY start_time, span_id
    LIMIT 200
)
SELECT
    concat(p.span_id, '/', c.span_id) AS id,
    p.span_id AS source,
    c.span_id AS target
FROM spans AS c
GLOBAL INNER JOIN spans AS p ON c.parent_span_id = p.span_id
WHERE c.parent_span_id != '' AND c.span_id != p.span_id
-- Preserve frame fields when ClickHouse returns zero rows.
UNION ALL
SELECT '__grafana_schema_only__', '', ''
